Q1: How should the new scheduled run, which targets every registered consumer, treat secrets that already exist in a consumer repository?
Choices:
A. Weekly schedule; only set secrets the consumer is missing, checked by listing its secret names (one extra API call per consumer); existing values are left alone, and a rotated library secret still reaches consumers through the existing manual dispatch. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Weekly schedule; overwrite all four secrets in every consumer on each run, which matches today's manual run with empty targets and also spreads a rotated library secret automatically.
C. Daily schedule; overwrite all four secrets in every consumer on each run.
D. Weekly schedule; only fill in missing secrets, but overwrite `GH_PAT` and `CHECK_TRIAGE_ISSUES_TOKEN` every time so a rotated token reaches every consumer.
